lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly ordered grid of circular high-luminance clusters arranged in roughly 12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 3 to 5 spots forming a rectilinear spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to create a clear grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high pixel intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 8-10 small, low-luminance spots confined to the anterior and middle sections of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the upper posterior margin of the first dorsal fin. A large, irregular pale patch is visible at the posterior insertion point of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible: one attached to the ventral surface of the left pectoral fin and two smaller individuals trailing beneath the ventral midline.
